headline: Waymo Halts US Freeway Robotaxi Operations After California Ban
summary: Alphabet's autonomous driving unit Waymo suspended robotaxi operations on US freeways following a regulatory ban in California, presenting an operational setback to its commercial rollout.
why: Regulatory authorization for highway speeds is essential for autonomous vehicle fleets seeking viable unit economics against traditional ride-hailing networks.

impacts.name: Alphabet
impacts.why: Its Waymo autonomous driving unit was forced to pull robotaxis off freeways after a regulatory prohibition.
